name: Occidental-Zij
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are acid rain regions, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

Dense air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Herds of six-limbed graziers shadow the meltwater margins, wary of anything that walks upright.
Nothing about the temporal distortion zone appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
